subject: QBR prep: roadmap stability and contingency planning for Acme integration
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmemedia.com>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acmemedia.com>
Date: Wed, 15 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR prep: roadmap stability and contingency planning for Acme integration

Team / Jane —

As we move into QBR prep next week, putting together a short (10–12 slide) readout focused on the product roadmap cadence and any launch timeline risks tied to the Acme integration. Key asks in this thread:

- Engineering/infra: confirm launch window we can guarantee for Acme (target date they requested: June 30). Highlight any blockers that would push that date.
- Product: call out scoped features that are "must-have" vs "nice-to-have" for the initial integration.
- Leadership: tradeoffs we want to escalate to execs (credits, delaying other work, additional headcount/contractor lift).

Attached: qbr_readout_v1.pdf (draft), acme_sow_timeline.xlsx (customer timeline).

Proposed timeline: final QBR deck ready by 5/22 EOD so I can circulate to the execs for preread. Can each of you reply with the single-line status + top-2 risks by EOD tomorrow?

Thanks —
Camila Reyes
Senior Product Manager, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com

Attachment: qbr_readout_v1.pdf (slides stub)
Attachment: acme_sow_timeline.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmemedia.com>
Date: Wed, 15 May 2028 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep: roadmap stability and contingency planning for Acme integration

Camila — good framing. Two quick leadership notes:

1) For the exec pack, we need a concise ask. If the team identifies a >2 week slippage risk on the Acme launch, be prepared to propose one of: (a) pull non-essential roadmap items from the June sprint, (b) temporary contractor support for infra, or (c) a negotiated phased launch with Acme (MVP + follow-up).
2) Put a small tab in the deck estimating incremental cost for each option (rough order of magnitude).

I'll defer to Marcus and Lauren for concrete timelines. Camila — include the ask as a single slide (options + recommended ask).

Vivek
VP, Product
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmemedia.com>
Date: Thu, 16 May 2028 08:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep: roadmap stability and contingency planning for Acme integration

Short status from Eng:

- Current committed scope to Acme MVP: API routing, tenant isolation, S3 connector, + billing usage tagging. 
- Blockers: two infra PRs (kv-cache eviction policy; multi-tenant S3 perms) are stuck in code review due to test flakes — likely 4–6 business days to clear if we allocate dedicated QA time.
- Capacity: the scheduled infra maintenance next week reduces available GPU capacity by ~20% for 48 hours (see infra_capacity_report.csv attached). That window overlaps with our planned performance tuning run.

Top 2 risks:
1) If PR review/QA takes longer than expected, we will miss the June 30 launch for feature-complete MVP.
2) The reduced capacity window could push perf tuning out a week, which cascades to certification with Acme.

Mitigation options: temporary re-prioritization of QA to unblock critical PRs (requires moving two lower-priority tickets out of sprint) or request a one-week phased launch with Acme (MVP without full perf tuning).

Marcus Lin
Eng Manager, Inference Runtime
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Attachment: infra_capacity_report.csv (CSV stub)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmemedia.com>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep: roadmap stability and contingency planning for Acme integration

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the clear callouts. From a delivery governance perspective:

- Recommendation: Do not delay certification with Acme. Instead, scope a thin "perf guardrails" set for launch (95th percentile latency goal for steady state) and commit to a 2-week post-launch optimization sprint with a documented acceptance criteria.
- Operational ask: product to produce a one-page rollback/upgrade plan we can hand to CS and Ops (triggers, rollback criteria, contact list).

If leadership prefers to preserve other roadmap items, I can pull the two lower-priority tickets out of the sprint to free QA cycles, but that will require commitment from Product to accept the reduced scope.

-Lauren
Director of Engineering Operations
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmemedia.com>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acmemedia.com>
Date: Sat, 18 May 2028 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep: roadmap stability and contingency planning for Acme integration

Thanks all — summary and mutual action plan below (to be pulled into the QBR deck):

1) Launch commitment: Target date still June 30, but contingency is a phased launch if critical perf tests miss the guardrail.
2) Scope: Cut list for MVP (must-have): API routing, tenant isolation, basic S3 connector, billing tags. Cut list for later (nice-to-have): UI reporting enhancements, advanced retention rules.
3) Mitigations:
   - Marcus/Eng: dedicate a 2-person QA rotation to unblock infra PRs this week.
   - Lauren/Ops: draft rollback/upgrade one-pager by 5/20.
   - Camila/Product: finalize acceptance criteria and slide for exec ask (options + recommended ask) by 5/22 EOD.
4) Exec ask: Approve contractor QA support for 3 weeks if the PR backlog doesn't clear by 5/19 (estimate $35k). Alternative: approve phased launch with Acme and a shared certification timeline.

Jane — can you confirm Acme is OK with a phased certification approach if needed? If procurement/contract requires a strict date, please flag.

I'll update the Google doc and QBR deck with these items now (link in related_links).

--
Camila Reyes
Senior Product Manager, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
